title: Delegate a wallet to a stake pool

summary.text: The Delegate wallet wizard has three steps: choose the wallet, choose the stake pool, and confirm. The new delegation takes effect after the current and the next epoch have completed.

problem.text: Stake ADA delegate choose pool delegation rewards

symptoms.text: Stake ADA delegate choose pool delegation rewards

user_phrases.text: Stake ADA delegate choose pool delegation rewards

daedalus.notes: Behavior read from the Daedalus 11.6.2 tag source and its English interface text. Check a newer release before relying on it for a later version.

causes.claim: A symptom alone does not establish a cause.

resolutions.action: Open Staking, select Delegation center, and select Delegate next to the wallet, or Redelegate if it is already delegated.
resolutions.why: The delegation center starts the delegation wizard for a wallet.

resolutions.action: Read the steps on Delegate wallet and select Continue.
resolutions.why: The wizard first lists its three steps.

resolutions.action: Check that the wallet you want is selected and select Continue.
resolutions.why: The wallet holds the funds to delegate.

resolutions.action: Select a stake pool from your recent choices or search the list, and select Continue.
resolutions.why: The stake pool receives the delegation.

resolutions.action: Check the stake pool ID and the fee that Daedalus shows.
resolutions.why: Confirmation is the last chance to check the choice before the transaction.

resolutions.action: With a software wallet, enter your spending password in Confirm Delegation and select Confirm. If Daedalus shows Review transaction instead, enter the password there and select Sign and send.
resolutions.why: Confirming sends the delegation transaction. Builds with the CIP-30 dApp connector show Review transaction instead of Confirm Delegation.

resolutions.action: With a hardware wallet, confirm the transaction on the device, then select Confirm in Confirm Delegation. If Daedalus shows Review transaction instead, select Continue on device and send, then confirm on the device.
resolutions.why: Confirm stays disabled until the device has confirmed the transaction; Review transaction passes the transaction to the device.

expected_outcome.text: Daedalus sends the delegation transaction, and the new delegation takes effect after the current and the next epoch have completed.

prerequisites: A wallet that has finished syncing and holds, besides rewards, the minimum amount of ADA that Daedalus states for delegation.
consequences: The fee and any deposit are paid from the wallet.
Your previous delegation stays active until the new one takes effect.
recovery: To move to a different pool, delegate the wallet again and choose that pool.

evidence.rationale: Official source inspection and Ariadne safety review; not wallet runtime testing.

faq.reason: Retrievable only; no FAQ item is published for this entry.
